historical_reviews.deepseek: Target presence is valid preflight but cannot satisfy actual state-transition coverage.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Adds systemd/vendor mapping, workload/filesystem guards, graceful execution, console/power/boot evidence and final-state recovery.

original_test_intent: Verify the Linux SUT safely reaches the approved equivalents of runlevels 0, 1, 3 and 6 and returns to the intended operational state.
original_method: Agent verifies mapping and may issue only approved graceful transitions; operator supervises rescue, off and reboot states through KVM/OOB, with complete service/filesystem/power/boot evidence.
manual_activity: User approves mapping/sequence/recovery; operator supervises rescue, poweroff and reboot through KVM/OOB while agent records each transition.
required_inputs: OS/init/systemd version and approved 0/1/3/6 target mapping
Exact sequence, dwell, return and abort criteria
Active service/workload and filesystem/RAID quiescence policy
Rescue authentication and local/KVM console procedure
Maintenance window, backup, BMC/OOB and known-event policy
safety_requirements: Validate mappings without state change before execution
Quiesce workloads and verify filesystem/RAID/boot health
Require live console/OOB before rescue, poweroff or reboot
Stop on target ambiguity, service/unmount timeout, console loss, hang, storage/boot/BMC fault or recovery loss
Do not blindly loop targets or force reboot
agent_execution_scope: Execute only separately approved graceful transitions
Do not choose sequence, expose credentials, repeat failures, force recovery or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve mapping, sequence, workload and recovery plan
Provide operator/rescue credentials and own recovery
Review all transition evidence and decide PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: systemctl list-units only establishes target availability; it cannot prove the required state was reached or that services/filesystems/power/boot recovered.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use vendor-supported graceful target transitions one at a time under KVM/OOB, verifying actual target/power/boot state and health before the next phase.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Runlevels 0/1/3/6, success Criteria and source 30/30 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat each runlevel as an independent transition transaction with preconditions, actual-state proof and return/health gate.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds explicit modern init mapping and recovery evidence without reducing actual execution coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Preflight/monitoring may be automated; rescue/off/reboot supervision and approval remain manual.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Legacy runlevel numbers may map differently or be compatibility symlinks on modern systems.

project_override_considerations: Project authority must define supported target equivalents and final state; the agent cannot assume legacy number semantics or count a target listing as execution.
expected_evidence: Critical approval and init/runlevel target map
Per-transition command, timestamps and actual target state
Service stop/unmount, rescue console and credential evidence
Complete OS/BMC/SEL logs, final operational state, recovery notes and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require actual runlevel execution; platform mapping is a prerequisite rather than conflicting intent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Mapping, sequence, console credentials, maintenance and recovery are supplyable inputs; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Converts a non-evidentiary target listing into individually gated, safely supervised actual state transitions with recovery proof.
independent_technical_reasoning: A target unit may exist yet fail to isolate because of dependencies, mounts or services, and runlevel 0/6 necessarily terminate the current session. Only console/BMC evidence plus the next boot/target state can prove those transitions, while rescue mode needs verified local authentication because networking may disappear.
